data.narrative:
Monaire is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Nishant Kanapilly and Rahul Subramany that has raised $4.1M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comp universe includes 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation triangulation was constrained by data availability. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables—while 8 Climate & Energy peers exist in the dataset, none of the narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded the minimum 3 datapoints required for meaningful median analysis. A sector-wide median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of company scale and maturity. Accordingly, Stage-Progression provided the sole quantitative anchor: applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-Series A step-up multiplier to the $4.1M raised proxy yields an implied valuation of $10M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $9M–$12M (median $10M), reflecting the Stage-Progression method result with ±15% bounds to account for company-specific risk factors and the method's reliance on fundraising stage alone rather than operational metrics. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or growth rate data, lack of sufficient peer comparables at the Seed stage, and the wide dispersion in maturity and capital intensity typical of early-stage Climate & Energy ventures.
